add media.description: Seed a local file into the device's camera roll/gallery (adb push + media scan on Android, simctl addmedia on iOS). CLI-side only — skipped in cloud mode. Makes a photo available to pick, but does not drive the app's own native image-picker UI to select it

call POST.description: Send a POST request with JSON body

clear.description: Clear the contents of a text field

clear optional.description: Attempt to clear; continue if not found

compare screenshot.description: Compare against a visual regression baseline

compare screenshot ... of.description: Scope the comparison to a single widget's on-screen bounds instead of the full screen

copy to clipboard.description: Copy text to the device clipboard

deliver signal.description: Resolve a pending awaitSignal(name) call in the app; value defaults to "true"

don't see ... in webview.description: Assert that no visible element matches. Passes when the element is absent or hidden; fails when the WebView cannot be reached at all. Android only

don't see native.description: Assert a native UI element matching the query is NOT present

double tap optional.description: Attempt a double tap; continue if not found

l10n \"key\".description: A string from the app's ARB files in the current app language (needs l10n.dir). Works wherever a quoted string does

log.description: Emit a message into the run output

long press optional.description: Attempt a long press; continue if not found

open link.description: Open a URL in the external browser via url_launcher

open link ... in the app.description: Route a URL to the app itself via the OS's intent/URL handling (adb/simctl), not the external browser. Also accepts into the app / in app. CLI-side only — skipped in cloud mode. On iOS Simulator this reliably works only when the app is already running (see the CHANGELOG for the cold-launch caveat)

read with ai into.prefix: read "the 6-digit OTP code" with ai into otp
read with ai into.body: read "${1:the 6-digit OTP code}" with ai into otp
read with ai into.description: Extract text off the current screen into a variable

retry N times.description: Re-run an indented block from the top on failure, up to N attempts, stopping at the first success

see ... in webview.description: Assert that a visible element with this text (or matching this selector) is in the WebView. Android only

see checked.description: Assert the switch, checkbox, radio (or their list tiles, filter or choice chips) is on; "not a checkable control" for anything else. don't see "Agree" is checked asserts it is off

see cpu below.description: Average / busiest-second CPU (percent of one core)

see exactly.description: Assert exact count of matching widgets

see exactly N requests.description: Count the requests the app made

see focused.description: Assert the widget currently holds keyboard focus

see matching.description: Assert that some widget found by the text selector has text matching the regex. Text selectors match substrings, so the anchored form is preferred for zero-state and count checks: see "0 ml" matching "^0 ml$". probe lint warns, without failing, about such a check that has no anchored pattern

see memory below.description: Peak memory / growth over the window

see native.description: Assert a native (non-Flutter) UI element matching the query is present — matched by uiautomator's text or resource-id. Android only; treated as "not found" on other platforms

see optional.description: Attempt the assertion; continue if it doesn't hold

see system dialog.description: Assert a system dialog is showing (don't see system dialog asserts none)

see with ai.prefix: see "the checkout total looks correct" with ai
see with ai.body: see "${1:the checkout total looks correct}" with ai

store.description: Store a literal or <var> value for use in later steps

store response.description: Keep a value from the body in <plan>

store text of ... in webview.prefix: store text of css:"#total" in webview as total
store text of ... in webview.body: store text of css:"${1:#total}" in webview as total
store text of ... in webview.description: Read the visible text of one element inside the app's WebView into a variable (a CSS selector only; whitespace collapsed, hidden characters dropped, at most 1000 characters). The value came from a page, so it can be typed, looked for and used in selectors, but open link, add media, set language, type native, screenshot names, call, mock, start measuring and system dialog steps refuse it. Needs a local Android device; see Reading text from a WebView

sync.description: Cross-device barrier — every device's steps block here until all arrive

tap if visible.description: Tap only if present, skip otherwise

tap native.description: Tap a native (non-Flutter) UI element — pickers, share sheets — matched by uiautomator's text or resource-id. Android only; errors clearly on other platforms. CLI-side only — skipped in cloud mode

tap optional.description: Attempt the tap; log a warning and continue if it fails

toggle.description: Toggle a switch or checkbox — accepts any selector (text, #id, ordinal) and dispatches it as a tap on the target

type.description: Enter text into a text field

type ... in webview.description: Focus an input inside the WebView and type into it. Refuses, typing nothing, when the element cannot take typed text: a disabled or read-only field, an input of a type that takes no text (checkbox, radio, file, button, range, color, date and time types), an element that is not a text field (a select, a button, a plain element), or one that does not take the focus. Text and number inputs, textareas and content-editable elements are typed into. Android only

type native.description: Focus a native text field matched by query, then type into it. Android only. If the field is reached via a screen transition (not already visible), add a wait step first — the same idiom used for Flutter navigation

type optional.description: Attempt to type; continue if the field isn't found

wait until ... appears in webview.prefix: wait until "Message sent" appears in webview
wait until ... appears in webview.body: wait until "${1:Message sent}" appears in webview
wait until ... appears in webview.description: Wait for a visible element inside the WebView, polling every 250 ms for the step's time limit. Android only

wait until appears matching.prefix: wait until "0 ml" appears matching "^0 ml$"
wait until appears matching.body: wait until "${1:0 ml}" appears matching "${2:^0 ml\$}"
wait until appears matching.description: Wait until a matched widget's text also matches the regular expression (exact text)

with examples from.description: Load examples from a CSV file
